_doc: LC v3a — Indian-market-optimized long calendar (no-code-change variant). May 7 2026. Designed from practitioner research (Zerodha/Sensibull/OptionX/ApexVol/Talkoptions + TastyTrade-recalibrated for India). Differences from v2/v2b: (1) VIX band tightened to 12-17 (Indian baseline ~15 vs US ~18 — Tasty's 15-22 maps to India's 12-17), (2) drop the CI+VRP regime gate entirely (regime-driven entry is wrong framework for calendars; calendar profits from term-structure dislocation + event IV crush), (3) profit target raised to 40% (cost-wall-adjusted from US 25%), (4) stop loss = 100% of debit (maximum possible loss anyway, makes the policy explicit), (5) front-close buffer reduced to 60 min (avoid SEBI Feb 2025 margin spike on expiry day with less theta-decay sacrifice). The full Indian-optimized design (with DoW filter + VIX percentile + IV-differential check + event-day awareness) requires code changes — those are flagged in LC_v3_INDIAN_OPTIMIZED.md. This v3a tests the CONFIGURATION-ONLY changes against the same 173-day post-SEBI corpus that LC v2/v2b ran on.
